scope: Two complete CPU A1/B1/B2/A2 blocks. Exact recorded native timing and separate solver RSS projections; reference timing samples; native full-family fingerprints and selected-family qualification. No GPU, full-corpus, causal or memory-saving claim. Paths are omitted; original report and audit SHA-256 values bind the retained sources.
